Key findings: side is ṣēlāʿ's dominant sense, rib the exceptional one, used of a human body only in Gen 2:21–22; BDB does NOT label Gen 2:15 cultic; šāmar 2:15/3:24 bookend; Eden serpent (sense 1d) distinct from the mythological dragon (sense 3). BDB misprint flagged: prints garden Genesis 2:16 (J) for the garden-tilling citation; the infinitive is in 2:15 — cite 2:15. BDB findings are BDB's, not current lexical consensus (HALOT/DCH not consulted).
